claim: h1 ('…menolak datang…, kata Polri')/l4/l5: Listyo Sigit Prabowo (eks Kapolri) did not attend his KKEP ethics hearing on Kamis 26 Nov 2026; per Kadiv Humas Polri Irjen Johnny Eddizon Isir he signed a berita acara penolakan kehadiran.
l1: The hearing was held Kamis pagi at Mabes Polri (Propam building); scheduled 09.00 WIB.
l2: Listyo is a suspect (tersangka) in alleged illegal wiretapping; per police the targets included the President (PART 1). Caption: 'tersangka dugaan penyadapan ilegal'.
l2b/caption: Since Mon 23 Nov 2026, Bareskrim (Kabareskrim Komjen Asep Safrudin) also named Listyo a suspect in dugaan makar (6 suspects).
l3: The panel is 5 three-star generals (Komjen), chaired by Komjen Hendro Pandowo (members: Rudi Darmoko, Dadang Hartanto, Dedy Kusuma Bakti, Dwiyono; on screen as name tags).
l6: Reason not explained (Isir: 'tidak dijelaskan secara eksplisit'); no response from his lawyer found (searched ~13.00 WIB 26 Nov).
l7: The KKEP panel (Ketua Komisi Komjen Hendro Pandowo) postponed the hearing to Senin 30 November 2026 and ordered him brought then; announced by Kadiv Humas Isir.

l9-l10: Under Perpol 7/2022 Pasal 108-109, KKEP sanctions include: conduct declared perbuatan tercela (etika); mutasi bersifat demosi paling singkat 1 tahun, penempatan pada tempat khusus paling lama 30 hari kerja, and PTDH (administratif). Not checked against the Perpol 4/2026 amendment.
l11: Prison is not in the KKEP sanction list (Pasal 107-109); criminal punishment goes through investigation and court.

h2/l12-l13: Hook 'Absen berapa kali, sidang jalan tanpa dia?' → '2 kali'. Perpol 7/2022 Pasal 59 ayat (3): not present after being lawfully summoned 2 times → the KKEP hearing proceeds without the accused. Senin 30 Nov is the 2nd summons (panggilan kedua, per VIVA/CNN/IDN); Isir: that session goes on to a verdict without him if he is absent.

l14: Per Polri (Isir), IF he is absent again on Senin 30 Nov, the verdict is final and binding and he loses the right to appeal (Pasal 65 huruf c Perpol 7/2022 jo. Perpol 4/2026). Conditional, not already final.
l15/caption: Ethics hearing is not a criminal trial; suspect status is not a guilty verdict (framing, no new fact).
Caption/end card: PART 1 posted 4 Nov (YT oK5ep48c3Wg, IG DfUTKP4jxd9), PART 3 posted 6 Nov (YT MU6pPpz2o0I).
